profile.headline: Software Engineer with 25 years experience
profile.summary: I'm a Principal Software Engineer with over 20 years of experience writing code in various languages.  Currently, my focus is primarily on front-end web development using Angular 10, but I'm comfortable with all parts of the development stack.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- UI development utilizing React and Next.js
- Designed and developed new web application using React and Next JS to replace legacy system
- Redesigned Java code and SQL queries from legacy system, yielding performance improvements up to 90%
- Developed and maintained Dockerfile to build container for React web application
- Created CI/CD pipelines in Gitlab to build application, run tests, create container, and deploy to RKE2 cluster
- Create documentation for the complex parts of a software system, detailing data flows, logic flows, and system component dependencies
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · Java · TS Clearance · Angular · Next.js

positions.title: Personal goal pursuit
positions.description:
Taking a sabbatical to pursue my hobbies in 3D modeling
Took part in Nodevember 2022. 15 challenges that must be procedurally generated 
- Learned blender geometry nodes and completed about half the challenges

Advent of code 2022 coding challenge
- 2 programming problems a day from December 1 - December 25
- Completed using Python

Experimenting with WebGL, THREE.js, and REACT

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Full stack developer on a web application using Go, Angular 5+, and MySQL. 

Provide technical guidance to development team on complex aspects of the system. Developed guidelines for front end development. Work with management to assign sprint tasking to other members of the team.

Perform product releases. Assist QA with any issues during testing.

Work closely with design team to assist with UI layouts. Implement designs using Angular and D3 for more complex graphical components. Develop component library with Storybook.
positions.insights: Skills: Relational Databases · Data Architecture · Full-Stack Development · Database Design · Data Modeling · Computer Science · Databases · TypeScript

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Design and develop web site that displays status of in house servers
•	Develop subsystem to generate customer contracts as PDF documents using Reportlabs
•	Develop system to generate DVD labels using Python Image Library
•	Develop SOAP based server used for application activation and authentication

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Technical Lead, Software Engineer,
Designed and developed Java application to perform sonar analysis. 

•	Designed and developed graphical user interfaces, including input forms, data graphs, metrics tables, maps, and 2D animations.
•	Managed project tasking, bug tracking, and release schedule.
•	Designed and implement eddatabase schemas in MySQL.
•	Developed data generator in Python that populates test databases based on GoogleEarth KML files.
•	Used informal agile development process.

Software Engineer
Team member on  Java project used to analyze radar performance.

•	Designed and developed graphical user interface, including graphs, 2D animations, and file editors.
•	Designed and created XML schema files used as program input.
•	Integrated with C++ library using JNI for lower-level functionality.
•	Used SCRUM development process.

Java Developer, MIRA
Worked as part of a small team to develop a network vulnerability analysis tool.

•	Designed and developed custom user interface components used to create and display networks
•	Developed custom views to display network node relationships 

Java Developer, Mission System LAN
Designed and developed complex displays utilizing scalable vector graphics (SVG)
for project that receives information from shipboard sensors and replicates common ship console displays
positions.insights: Skills: Relational Databases · Database Design · Data Modeling · Computer Science · Databases

company.name: The Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Java Technical Lead, Software Engineer, 2003 - 2004
Trained coworkers in use of company developed programming environment and architecture

Software Engineer, 1998 - 2003

•	Software engineer for multi-national defense contracting corporation, specializing in NBC (Nuclear, Biological, and Chemical) threat analysis.
•	Cross platform development and code porting in C++ on Microsoft Windows, Redhat Linux, and Solaris operating systems
•	Took part in full life-cycle of project development, including design, documentation, coding, testing, and customer demonstartions
•	Project design using UML developed in Visio and Rational Rose
